name: Artefact Projects Limited
about: Artefact Projects Limited, an engineering and project management consultancy company, provides solutions for infrastructure development in India. The company offers services in planning, design, engineering, project management, and supervision across highways, bridges, flyovers, urban infrastructure, buildings, railways, airports, water resources, and other key infrastructure sectors. It also operates as consulting engineers, architects, and planners. In addition, the company engages in the design of municipal roads, pavements, and underground utility ducts, as well as quality assurance and control services of various road and trench works. It serves various central and state government departments, public sector undertakings, and other statutory authorities. The company was formerly known as Artefact Software and Finance Limited and changed its name to Artefact Projects Limited in January 2007. Artefact Projects Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Nagpur, India.
